title: Gacha Pool Definition
description: Defines a gacha banner/pool with weighted entries, pity threshold, and featured monster rate-ups. Used by GachaRoller to perform pulls.

name.description: Display name of the gacha banner.

cost_amount.description: Amount of currency consumed per single pull.

pity_threshold.description: Number of pulls without a top-rarity result before a guaranteed top-rarity pull. 0 means no pity system.

entries.description: Weighted list of pullable entries in this pool.

featured_ids.description: Monster IDs that receive a rate-up in this banner.

monster_id.description: Reference to the monster definition ID.

weight.description: Relative weight for weighted random selection. Higher weight means more likely to be pulled.

is_featured.description: Whether this entry is a featured/rate-up monster in the current banner.
